director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya
Aaj hum ek poore ke barabar hisse karke bhinn banayenge. Toh shuru karte hain?
samajh nahi aaya

Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon. Ghar mein ek roti 4 bachchon mein barabar baantni hai. Har hisse ka ek naam hota hai. Yeh roti 4 barabar hisson mein bati hai. Rang wala ek hissa poori roti ka 1/4 hai. Poore ke barabar hisson mein se aisa ek hissa fractional unit kehlata hai. Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

seams.form: Theek hai, main shuru karti hoon.

director.text: 1/4 sahi nahi hai. Aath dost yeh roti barabar baantein, toh har dost ko ek hissa milta hai; us hisse ka naam doston ki ginti se banta hai, pehli roti ke 4 se nahi. 8 barabar hisson wali roti ka ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Ab bagal wali roti dekho, utni hi badi, par 8 barabar hisson mein bati. Uska ek hissa kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao
Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon. Doosri roti ke 8 hisse hain, sab ek jitne bade. Unmein se ek hisse ko kya naam doge?
director.card: Doosri roti ke 8 hisse hain, sab ek jitne bade. Unmein se ek hisse ko kya naam doge?

seams.form: Achha, ab Hindi mein bolti hoon.

director.text: 1/8 wala hissa

Bilkul sahi, kyunki roti ke 8 barabar hisse, aur yeh unmein se ek. Do pattiyan dekho, dono ke 3 hisse. A ke teeno hisse barabar hain, toh har hissa 1/3 hai. B ke hisse chhote-bade hain, toh unhe gin kar 1/3 nahi keh sakte. Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: teeno

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Isko ek naye dhang se dekhein. Dono pattiyon ke teen hisse, par barabar sirf pehli ke. Koi hissa 1/3 tab hai, jab uske jaise teen hisse milkar poori patti banayein. 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

seams.form: Isko ek naye dhang se dekhein.

director.text: drawing karke samjhao
Yahan wahi ribbon scale par hai; nishaan wahan hain jahan woh kati. 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hisson wali 24 cm ki ribbon mein, kitne hisse 1/3 hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

director.text: ek aur picture dikhao
Board wali drawing hi iski akeli drawing hai. Ab tum batao.
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

seams.form: Board wali drawing hi iski akeli drawing hai.

director.text: 3 sahi nahi hai. Teen hisse gin lene se har hissa 1/3 nahi banta; 1/3 sirf woh hissa hai jo 24 cm ko teen barabar hisson mein kaatne par bane hisse jitna lamba ho. 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

director.text: pehle main try karun?
Haan, pehle tum try karo.
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

director.text: Nahi, 3 theek nahi. Pehle socho, 24 cm ke teen barabar hisse kitne lambe hote. Phir har hisse ko usse milao. 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hisson wali 24 cm ki ribbon mein, kitne hisse 1/3 hain?
director.card: 24 cm ki ribbon ke 3 hisse 10, 8 aur 6 cm ke hain. Inmein poori ribbon ke 1/3 jitne hisse kitne hain?

director.text: 1 hai na

Bilkul sahi. Suno, 24 cm ka 1/3 24 ÷ 3 = 8 cm hai, aur 8 cm ka hissa sirf 1 hai. Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain. Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

seams.form: Chalo, ab pichhle sawaal par wapas chalte hain.

director.text: teeno
Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Hisse teen hain, par ek jitne lambe nahi; chhote-bade hisse gin kar har ek ko 1/3 nahi keh sakte. 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hisson wali 15 cm ki patti mein, kaunsa hissa 1/3 hai?
director.card: Socho, ek aur 15 cm ki patti ke hisse 7, 5 aur 3 cm ke hain. Kaunsa hissa uska 1/3 hai?

director.text: second wala

Haan, bilkul theek: patti ke teen barabar hisse 5-5 cm ke hote. Ab do ribbon lo: P 20 cm ki, Q 12 cm ki. P ka 1/2 10 cm hai, aur Q ka 1/2 6 cm. Naam ek hai, 1/2, par poora alag hai, isliye lambai alag hai. Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: pata nahi
Pehle har ribbon ko alag se 4 barabar hisson mein kaato. Phir dono ka ek-ek hissa milao. 20 cm ki ribbon P ka 1/4, 12 cm ki ribbon Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?
director.card: Ab dono ribbon ka 1/4 lo. P ka 1/4, Q ke 1/4 se kitne cm lamba hai?

director.text: 2 cm lamba

Sahi jawab, kyunki P ka 1/4 5 cm, Q ka sirf 3 cm. Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain. Dadi ne 30 cm lamba ganna barabar hisson mein kaata, aur har hissa 6 cm ka hai. Ab dekhna hai ki ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai. Ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata, yeh kis hisaab se nikaaloge?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal milkar, kadam-kadam hal karte hain.

director.text: 6 se bhaag denge

Haan, 30 ko 6 se bhaag do, toh pata chalega ganna kitne hisson mein bata. Dhyaan rakhna, fractional unit ke neeche hisse ki lambai 6 nahi aati; neeche woh ginti aati hai ki ganna kitne barabar hisson mein bata. Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?
director.card: Tumhari baari: 6 cm wala ek hissa poore ganne ka kaunsa fractional unit hai?

director.text: ek bata paanch

Bilkul sahi. Toh poora jawab: ek hissa poore ganne ka 1/5 hai. Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo. 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?
director.card: 16 cm lambi chocolate toot kar 6, 2, 6 aur 2 cm ke hisson mein bat gayi. Inmein se kitne hisse poori chocolate ka 1/4 hain?

seams.form: Ab ek sawaal tum akele karo.

director.text: koi bhi nahi

Haan, bilkul theek. Suno, 16 cm ka 1/4 16 ÷ 4 = 4 cm hota, aur koi bhi hissa 4 cm ka nahi, toh 0 hisse. Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?
director.card: Ek ribbon 60 cm ki hai aur doosri 30 cm ki. Rahul ne pehli ka 1/3 liya, aur Sana ne doosri ka 1/2. Dono ke hisson mein kitne cm ka fark hai?

director.text: 5 cm fark

Haan, sahi hai: Rahul ka hissa 60 ÷ 3 = 20 cm, Sana ka 30 ÷ 2 = 15 cm; 20 − 15 = 5. Ab ek hi poore ko kabhi kam, kabhi zyada barabar hisson mein baantenge, aur dekhenge ki ek hissa kaise badalta hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
aapko virat pasand hai?
Main AI teacher hoon, isliye meri apni koi pasand nahi hoti. Tumhe Virat ke baare mein sabse achha kya lagta hai?
sixer

Wah, sixer! Toh yeh tumhe achha lagta hai. Achha, ab wapas apne kaam par. Yeh do pattiyan bilkul ek jaisi hain. Pehli 3 barabar hisson mein bati hai, doosri 6 mein. 6 bada number hai, phir bhi 1/6 wala hissa 1/3 wale se chhota hai, kyunki wahi patti zyada hisson mein bati. Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?
director.card: Doosri patti ke kitne 1/6 hisse milkar pehli patti ka ek 1/3 hissa banate hain?

seams.form: Achha, ab wapas apne kaam par.

j2.line: Wah, sixer! Toh yeh tumhe achha lagta hai.

director.text: do hisse

Bilkul sahi. Har 1/3 jitni jagah mein do 1/6. Ab teen chocolate ki pattiyan lo, teeno ek hi size ki. Pehli 3 doston mein barabar bati, doosri 5 mein, teesri 10 mein. Jitne zyada dost, har dost ka hissa utna chhota. Teeno chocolate ke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?
director.card: Teeno chocolate ke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?

director.text: 1/3 sahi nahi hai. Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Do ek jaisi roti: ek 2 logon mein bati, doosri 8 mein. 8 bada number hai, phir bhi 8 logon wala hissa chhota, kyunki roti wahi hai. Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?
director.card: Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?

seams.form: Ise alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: Nahi, 1/4 theek nahi. 4 sabse chhota number hai, par 4 hisson wali dor par kainchi sabse kam baar chali, toh uske hisse sabse lambe hain, chhote nahi. 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati teen ek jitni dor mein se kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?
director.card: Teen ek jitni dor 6, 9 aur 4 barabar hisson mein kati. Kis dor ka ek hissa sabse chhota hai?

director.text: nau wali

Haan, bilkul theek: teeno dor ek jitni, par 9 wali sabse zyada hisson mein kati, toh uska hissa 1/9 sabse chhota. Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain. 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5: inmein sabse chhota hissa kaun hai?
director.card: Teeno chocolate ke hisson mein sabse chhota kaunsa hai: 1/3, 1/10 ya 1/5?

seams.form: Achha, ab pehle wale sawaal ko phir se dekhte hain.

director.text: 1/10 wala

Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 doston wala hissa sabse chhota, phir 5 wala, phir 3 wala, toh 1/10 sabse chhota. Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge. Ek patti barabar baantni hai. Hissa 1/3 se chhota par 1/6 se bada chahiye, aur dost 2, 4 ya 7 ho sakte hain. Dekhna hai patti kitne doston mein baantein. Har option ke liye pehle kya nikaaloge?

seams.form: Aao, agla sawaal main aur tum mil ke karenge.

director.text: ab main jaati hoon, bye
Aaj ke liye itna hi, phir milte hain.
